newForms.name: Brimlord
newForms.lore: Its pitchfork got an upgrade. So did the mischief.

newForms.name: Direlord
newForms.lore: Commands lesser implings with a single raised eyebrow.

newForms.name: Archdemon
newForms.lore: Ember Scar's oldest joke: it started as a prank, and the prank became a kingdom.

newForms.name: Duskgloom
newForms.lore: Wears its crown a little crooked, on purpose, to seem more approachable.

newForms.name: Nightgloom
newForms.lore: Whole caves fall quiet when it passes, out of respect or dread — it's never entirely sure which.

newForms.name: Umbragloom
newForms.lore: The deepest hollow in Mistveil Marsh has always belonged to it. The marsh just took a while to admit it.

newForms.name: Warbrute
newForms.lore: Leads by example, mostly the example of hitting things very hard.

newForms.name: Warkhan
newForms.lore: Every scar has a story. It has stopped telling most of them, out of mercy for the listener.

newForms.name: Warmonarch
newForms.lore: United every orc camp in the Scar under one banner: whichever one it happened to be holding.

newForms.name: Scorchquid
newForms.lore: Its ink is basically hot sauce at this point. Nobody's tested how hot.

newForms.name: Magmaquid
newForms.lore: Eight arms, eight tiny trails of molten glass wherever it swims.

newForms.name: Infernoquid
newForms.lore: Local smiths swear the best-tempered blades cooled in a pool it recently visited.

newForms.name: Cinderkraken
newForms.lore: The Ember Scar's lava lakes have a current now, and the current has a temper.

newForms.name: Voltguard
newForms.lore: Its plating hardened into proper armor. Still stings first, apologises never.

newForms.name: Stormguard
newForms.lore: Patrols Stormreach's ridgelines in a hum you feel before you hear.

newForms.name: Voltsovereign
newForms.lore: The hive answers to it completely, and it answers only to the next thunderhead.

newForms.name: Voltxen
newForms.lore: Built a bigger antenna. Still hasn't picked up a signal home.

newForms.name: Starxen
newForms.lore: Has started mapping the storms instead, just in case one of them is the way back.

newForms.name: Cosmarch
newForms.lore: Stopped looking for home and started building one; Stormreach's peaks now answer to its call.

newForms.name: Glacilord
newForms.lore: Built a proper ice-fort. Snowball fights are now a formal event.

newForms.name: Frostgiant
newForms.lore: Its footsteps carve the paths every winter caravan follows without knowing why.

newForms.name: Frostmonarch
newForms.lore: Stormreach's worst blizzards are just it, having a particularly good day.

newForms.name: Shadowblade
newForms.lore: Trained under actual shadows. The shadows are reportedly impressed.

newForms.name: Nightfang
newForms.lore: Strikes between one heartbeat and the next, then is gone before the second.

newForms.name: Kagesoul
newForms.lore: Some Wayfarers swear they've felt it pass. None have ever managed to see it.

newForms.name: Voltmage
newForms.lore: Finally found a textbook. It was mostly wrong, which somehow helped.

newForms.name: Stormsage
newForms.lore: Teaches lightning theory to anyone who'll stand close enough to listen (and survive).

newForms.name: Tempestmage
newForms.lore: Argues with actual thunderheads about the correct pronunciation of 'cumulonimbus'.

newForms.name: Archtempest
newForms.lore: The school may be gone, but its best and only graduate never stopped adding to the syllabus.

newForms.name: Willowisp
newForms.lore: Leads travelers home by the longest, prettiest possible route. No one seems to mind.

newForms.name: Moorwisp
newForms.lore: Two lights now drift where one used to — it's teaching a younger wisp the paths.

newForms.name: Ladylantern
newForms.lore: Marsh-folk leave a candle out for her on foggy nights, out of habit and gratitude both.

newForms.name: Soulguide
newForms.lore: Every lost path in Mistveil Marsh eventually leads somewhere warm, because of her.

prompts.name: Impling
prompts.prompt: A small mischievous imp with tiny bat wings and a miniature pitchfork, dusky red skin and a wide impish grin.

prompts.name: Hellion
prompts.prompt: A taller horned demon with bigger wings and a crackling laugh, deeper red skin with dark markings, pitchfork now properly sized.

prompts.name: Brimlord
prompts.prompt: A broader demon with curling ram-like horns and wings edged in ember-light, deep crimson skin patterned with glowing cracks like cooling lava.

prompts.name: Direlord
prompts.prompt: An imposing horned demon lord with an ornate bone pitchfork and wide leathery wings, dark garnet skin glowing at every crack, a commanding smirk.

prompts.name: Archdemon
prompts.prompt: A towering demon sovereign with vast wings of flame-edged leather and a crown of curling horns, near-black crimson skin blazing with molten fissures, its grin equal parts menace and delight.

prompts.name: Gloomling
prompts.prompt: A small imp-like creature hanging upside down from a branch, violet-grey skin and wide glowing eyes, giggling at nothing in particular.

prompts.name: Gloomlord
prompts.prompt: A taller goblin-like figure with a crooked little crown and clawed hands, deeper violet skin with faint glowing veins, a sly knowing grin.

prompts.name: Duskgloom
prompts.prompt: A broader goblin lord with a more ornate bone crown and longer claws, deep violet-grey skin glowing faintly along its veins, still grinning slyly.

prompts.name: Nightgloom
prompts.prompt: An imposing shadow-wreathed figure with a jagged crown and a trailing cloak of living darkness, indigo skin marked with glowing violet runes.

prompts.name: Umbragloom
prompts.prompt: A towering void sovereign draped in shifting shadow-cloth and crowned in curling dark horns, deep violet-black skin glowing with slow-pulsing runic light.

prompts.name: Grunt
prompts.prompt: A small stocky orc with a crude wooden club and a determined scowl, dusty tan-green skin and simple leather straps.

prompts.name: Warlord
prompts.prompt: A broader orc warrior with a proper stone axe and battle-worn armor, deeper olive skin with scars, a commanding stance.

prompts.name: Warbrute
prompts.prompt: A heavily muscled orc brute with a massive rock-headed maul and layered hide armor, weathered bronze-green skin marked with war-paint.

prompts.name: Warkhan
prompts.prompt: An imposing orc chieftain in spiked stone armor with a trophy-hung belt, deep umber-green skin crossed with old scars, a steady commanding gaze.

prompts.name: Warmonarch
prompts.prompt: A towering orc warmonarch in ornate boulder-plate armor and a banner-topped horned helm, rich earthen bronze skin, radiating the authority of a hundred won battles.

prompts.name: Cinderquid
prompts.prompt: A small squid with stubby glowing tentacles trailing faint smoke, deep red-orange body with a soft round mantle.

prompts.name: Scorchquid
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger squid whose tentacle-tips now flicker with tiny flames, richer red mantle with brighter ember-glow patterns.

prompts.name: Magmaquid
prompts.prompt: A broader squid with longer tentacles trailing continuous embers, deep magma-red mantle cracked with glowing orange seams.

prompts.name: Infernoquid
prompts.prompt: A powerful squid whose whole mantle glows like a coal, its many tentacles wreathed in drifting flame, dark ember-red skin veined in gold light.

prompts.name: Cinderkraken
prompts.prompt: A colossal lava-kraken with a crown of massive flame-wreathed tentacles and a mantle like cooling obsidian, glowing gold fissures pulsing across its whole body.

prompts.name: Zapbee
prompts.prompt: A small round bee with thin crackling wings and a soft yellow-black striped body, tiny spark-flecks trailing from its stinger.

prompts.name: Voltarmor
prompts.prompt: A larger armored bee with plated chitin and buzzing lightning-fast wings, deeper gold-black striping with a hardened glossy shell.

prompts.name: Voltguard
prompts.prompt: A sturdier armored bee with thicker plate segments along its thorax and crackling wing-edges, rich gold-bronze chitin with darker battle stripes.

prompts.name: Stormguard
prompts.prompt: An imposing sentinel-bee with heavy layered armor plates and wings that leave visible spark-trails, deep bronze-gold shell veined with glowing lightning cracks.

prompts.name: Voltsovereign
prompts.prompt: A magnificent armored bee sovereign crowned in crystalline plate and trailing constant arcs of lightning from every wing-edge, radiant gold-bronze chitin glowing at every seam.

prompts.name: Zorp
prompts.prompt: A small grey alien with a stubby antenna and huge curious eyes, smooth pale lavender-grey skin crackling faintly with static.

prompts.name: Xenobolt
prompts.prompt: A taller alien with a longer antenna and slender limbs, deeper grey-violet skin marked with faint circuit-like lightning patterns.

prompts.name: Voltxen
prompts.prompt: A leaner alien with an elaborate branching antenna array and glowing circuit-patterns across its limbs, cool slate-violet skin crackling at the fingertips.

prompts.name: Starxen
prompts.prompt: An imposing alien with a crown-like antenna cluster and skin patterned in constellations of tiny glowing dots, deep indigo-grey and faintly luminous.

prompts.name: Cosmarch
prompts.prompt: A regal alien sovereign with a radiant crown of branching antennae like captured lightning, deep cosmic-violet skin glowing with slow-drifting star-like patterns across every limb.

prompts.name: Frostling
prompts.prompt: A small round yeti cub with shaggy white fur and stubby arms, rosy cheeks and bright curious eyes peeking through the fluff.

prompts.name: Glaciator
prompts.prompt: A bulkier young yeti with thick shaggy fur and sturdy limbs, pale blue-white coat with a determined, snowball-ready stance.

prompts.name: Glacilord
prompts.prompt: A broader yeti with denser fur and small ice-crystal formations along its shoulders, frost-pale coat glinting faintly blue in the cold.

prompts.name: Frostgiant
prompts.prompt: A towering yeti giant with heavy ice-plated shoulders and a thick frosted mane, pale icy-blue fur crusted with glittering frost patterns.

prompts.name: Frostmonarch
prompts.prompt: A colossal yeti sovereign crowned in a jagged ice-crown and draped in frost-crusted fur, radiant pale blue-white coat glittering like fresh snow under its own cold light.

prompts.name: Shadekin
prompts.prompt: A small lean ninja-shaped creature in a dark hood, teal-grey cloth wrappings and sharp watchful eyes, barely a shadow's outline.

prompts.name: Shinobi
prompts.prompt: A taller, more agile ninja figure with a flowing scarf and twin blades, deeper slate-teal wrappings and a poised, silent stance.

prompts.name: Shadowblade
prompts.prompt: A leaner, faster ninja with a longer trailing scarf and a single curved blade, dark teal-grey wrappings blending into shifting shadow at the edges.

prompts.name: Nightfang
prompts.prompt: An elite shadow-warrior wrapped in wind-torn cloth with twin glinting blades, near-black teal garb that seems to blur at the edges mid-motion.

prompts.name: Kagesoul
prompts.prompt: A legendary shadow-master barely more than a suggestion of movement, dark storm-teal wrappings trailing like smoke, twin blades catching light that shouldn't be there.

prompts.name: Sparkmage
prompts.prompt: A slim robed figure crackling with static, holding a crooked wooden staff topped with a small spark, pale grey robes with yellow lightning trim.

prompts.name: Voltmage
prompts.prompt: A more composed robed spellcaster with a sturdier staff and a small floating spark-orb, richer grey-gold robes crackling faintly at the hem.

prompts.name: Stormsage
prompts.prompt: A confident storm-scholar in layered robes with a crystal-topped staff, deep charcoal-gold robes patterned with faint lightning-bolt embroidery.

prompts.name: Tempestmage
prompts.prompt: A powerful storm mage wreathed in a faint crackling aura, ornate gold-trimmed robes billowing as if caught in a permanent squall, staff topped with a captured storm cloud.

prompts.name: Archtempest
prompts.prompt: A magnificent archmage of the storm, robes of deep stormcloud-grey and gold lightning trim swirling around them, staff crowned with a permanently crackling miniature thundercloud.

prompts.name: Wisp
prompts.prompt: A small drifting flame-light with a faint humanoid shimmer inside, soft violet-white glow trailing thin wisps of light.

prompts.name: Willowisp
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger drifting light with a clearer flickering silhouette inside, warmer pale gold-violet glow trailing longer light-ribbons.

prompts.name: Moorwisp
prompts.prompt: A brighter wandering light trailing a second smaller spark beside it, soft lilac-gold glow with a more defined gentle silhouette.

prompts.name: Ladylantern
prompts.prompt: An elegant glowing figure wrapped in trailing light like a lantern-lit gown, warm cream-gold glow with a serene, motherly presence.

prompts.name: Soulguide
prompts.prompt: A radiant guiding spirit crowned in soft golden light with long flowing ribbons of glow trailing like a comet's tail, its warm presence lighting the whole marsh path ahead.
